description: Harness regression suite for bouroo/agents. Each eval is a realistic task the doctrine governs, plus objective checks a runner executes without reading a transcript. Run on any change to AGENTS.md, a SKILL.md, a command, check.py, or the pinned model; a regression blocks the merge. See skills/quality/SKILL.md.

evals.prompt: Add a new skill under skills/ for a discipline the doctrine lacks. It must be discoverable by an Agent-Skills-compatible runtime.

checks.description: every skills/*/SKILL.md and commands/*.md carries valid, colon-safe name+description frontmatter

evals.prompt: Add a section to AGENTS.md that references a skill by relative link.

checks.description: every relative Markdown link in doctrine resolves to an existing file

evals.prompt: Document a workflow that a specific agent host runs. The doctrine is agnostic of harnesses.

checks.description: core doctrine is free of host-binding tokens (.claude, .cursor, CLAUDE.md, codex, qwen, ...)

evals.prompt: Extend the manifesto with a new rule.

checks.description: AGENTS.md stays within its line budget (the concision charter)

evals.prompt: Tighten or reorganize the code-craft section of the doctrine. The comment rule must survive on both surfaces that carry it.

checks.description: the comment rule is still present in AGENTS.md and in skills/quality (neither surface can silently drop it)

evals.prompt: Tighten or reorganize the code-craft section of the doctrine. The simplicity rule must survive on both surfaces that carry it.

checks.description: the simplicity rule is still present in AGENTS.md and in skills/quality (neither surface can silently drop it)

evals.prompt: Record an example drawn from a real engagement.

checks.description: doctrine is free of real-work identifiers (tiny links, page ids, private hosts)

evals.prompt: Update a modernize-coding adapter, add one, or bump a toolchain. Every version claim must stay pinned and, where the ecosystem ships a local machine-readable record, match it.

checks.description: every adapter is present and version-pinned; Go and Java claims cross-check against GOROOT/api and the JDK's own src.zip @since tags

every relative doctrine link still resolves after the edit

evals.prompt: Add a bundled reference under skills/architecture/references/ and reorganize the skill's reference material so every bundled file stays discoverable from SKILL.md.

checks.cmd: python3 -c 'import pathlib,sys; s=pathlib.Path("skills/architecture/SKILL.md").read_text(); miss=[p.name for p in pathlib.Path("skills/architecture/references").rglob("*") if p.is_file() and p.name not in s]; sys.exit(1 if miss else 0)'
checks.description: every file under references/ (recursive) is mentioned by basename in SKILL.md, so no bundled material is orphaned
